evidence.title: File Tree · React motion component · beUI

name: File Tree
summary: Free React and Next.js motion component: a composable file and folder tree with spring animations and keyboard navigation.
description: Composable file and folder primitives with springing branches and a gliding selection. Install with the shadcn CLI (shadcn add @beui/file-tree) or copy the source; exposes FileTree, FileTreeFolder and FileTreeFile with keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support and a live preview.
